title: Schur decomposition with logarithmic precision in cubic time up to squared logarithmic factors
abstract: A finite randomised floating-point program computes an approximate complex Schur decomposition for every input of spectral norm at most one. For tolerance delta and requested failure probability p in (0,1/2), the joint residual and orthogonality errors are at most delta with probability at least 1-p. The program uses logarithmically many significand and natural control-word bits, and cubic work times a squared logarithm. Exact triangular storage and the work bound hold on every execution.
